items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that condition V makes the pullback map on cohomology injective with image the classes that become trivial on a covering (statement lines 7060-7068). The proof (proof lines 7070-7087) identifies the map as the pullback along epsilon_X, writes the five-term exact sequence given by the Leray spectral sequence and the assumed vanishing, and reads the statement off it. H2: one reformulation plus one exact sequence, written out.
